notes.title: Multiplayer Released! Time to compete for "Top Shot" with your buddies
notes.content:
[h1]Introducing Multiplayer "Time Attack" with Birds[/h1]

[b]Who can bag the most birds in the allotted time? [/b]

Wing shooting practice in Farmer John's field to shoot the crows eating the crops - with the help of Buddy the Dog retrieving the birds.

Scenarios up to 8 players

[list]
[*] Dust off your shotguns for spring. 
[*] Get ready for that next hunting trip! 
[*] Figure out your leads with moving targets.
[/list]

The most accurate shotgun shooting multiplayer simulator in the world!

Don't forget to practice the most traditional shooting clay target games at Lakeside Gunclub! With accurate scoring and game type implementation.
[list]
[*] Skeet, Trap, Doubles Trap, 5 Stand
[/list]

A true to life shotgun moving target sports simulator. We've programmed in all the variables and it doesn't get any more realistic. Learn all the rules to the games and be ready to play.
